item.title: How to create custom pipes in Angular
item.description: Creating custom pipes in Angular enables specialized data transformations that aren’t available with built-in pipes, providing reusable logic for specific business requirements and formatting needs. As the creator of CoreUI with extensive Angular experience since 2014, I’ve developed numerous custom pipes for enterprise applications requiring specialized formatting, filtering, and data transformation logic. The most effective approach involves implementing the PipeTransform interface with the @Pipe decorator to create reusable, performant transformation functions. This method provides clean separation of presentation logic while maintaining Angular’s change detection optimization and template readability.
